messages:
anya: FYI support reports EU customers getting duplicate charges after resume. Proxy sometimes rewrites sticky lease header to 0 and our route gate still treats it as sticky.

matt: Grabbed logs: nginx error -> downstream sees header x-sticky-lease=0 and we forward. example: [2026-03-24T09:12:01Z] resume_id=zzz sticky_lease=0 -> accept.

josh: Billing treats any resume_accept as continuation. We need lease validation before billing. Two paths: reject stale resume (409) or accept+suppress billing.

emily: Console telemetry is noisy. Can we emit resume_status=(ok|stale|missing) + route_shard so ops can filter? Also show resume rejection reason in the UI.

devex: Short-term client UX: return 409 {"error":"resume_stale","hint":"lease expired"} so SDKs can prompt a full reconnect.

matt: For safety: default server behavior -> reject when lease header present && TTL < now (409). For canary flag -> accept but tag resume_stale=true and suppress billing. This lets us roll out without user-facing regressions.

josh: I'll add billing_suppressed flag on session state and make ledger ops idempotent for retro-billing if we decide to bill later.

sre-ops: Add alert: resume_stale_rate > 0.5% in EU over 10m. Also add runbook to inspect proxy rewrites.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled for eng-platform/resume-lease-guard at 2026-03-24T12:00:00Z (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%).

anya: Action owners: matt server guard + tests, josh ledger changes, emily telemetry + console row, devex SDK note. We'll flip per-tenant flag for canary.
matt: landing PR today.
josh: working on tests.
emily: will add dashboard row and tooltip.
